findings.target: A5 answer + reader question + brief takeaway
findings.finding: Manifest A5 answer says 'a 22-state suit is pending' (from the scout bullet). NY AG release says NY led 21 other AGs plus the governor of Pennsylvania; the 21 others are 20 states plus DC, so the plaintiffs are 21 states plus DC plus PA's governor (22 AG offices).
findings.fix: WRITE must not print '22-state'. Use 'New York and 20 other states plus DC, joined by Pennsylvania's governor' (or 'a coalition of 22 attorneys general'), recounted from the NY AG release and the complaint/Federal Register text. Frame the suit as pending: no injunction or vacatur verified, so the rule is not blocked unless a court order exists at publication; recheck docket status before writing.

findings.finding: Lockup terms from the 424B4 were not read. The 424B4 main document (anthropicpbc-424b4.htm, 14 MB) exceeds WebFetch's 10 MB cap and SEC returns 403 to a contact-less client; the existing page's 180/365-day figures come from the S-1.
findings.fix: WRITE: if the 424B4 lockup section cannot be read in this run, attribute the 180-day and 365-day lockups explicitly to the S-1 ('the S-1 described...; the final prospectus controls, read its lock-up section') and do not state exact expiry dates or a calendar of unlock dates. findings.finding: Only CNBC (fetched, extraction) says ANT fell 6.5% Tuesday and closed below $83; no dollar close, no 7.3% premarket figure (x.com 402). Nov 19 close $97.17 is secondary web search only.
findings.fix: Write 'closed below the $83 IPO price on Nov 24, according to CNBC'. Do not print a dollar close, a percent drop figure beyond CNBC's 6.5%, or the Nov 19 $97.17 close. Open-price buyers at $111.50 are down more than 25% at any price at or below $83 (calculated: 83/111.50 - 1 = -25.6%); label as arithmetic, not a measured close. Give analyst targets only as CNBC-attributed. Because the price moves daily, date-stamp every price statement and avoid present-tense 'is trading at'. Do not give a sell/hold/buy instruction; conditional framing by holder type and horizon, with a not-personalized-advice limit.

findings.finding: The scout says the limit applies to loans 'delivered to Fannie Mae on/after Jan 1, 2027'; FHFA only says limits apply to mortgages the Enterprises 'can acquire in 2027'. No delivery-date rule is verified.
findings.fix: Page must not assert a delivery-date rule or that closing in December vs January decides which limit applies. State FHFA's wording (limits for mortgages the Enterprises can acquire in 2027), say a lender decides which year's limit a given loan falls under, and answer 'does waiting until January help' conditionally: only for a loan between $832,750 and $855,400 (or the equivalent county band) and only if the lender confirms. Table is calculated: label 'In our internal calculation' with formula limit / (1 - down payment share), floor of the county-limit case, and note it ignores financed fees such as FHA-type premiums and that a lender may set its own jumbo thresholds. No invented jumbo rate premium.
